title: 第十九章 搅棍开始搅第二十章 雪满川和沈红叶的行踪
slug: 种魔得仙第两千三十二章开了
content_zh:
;;
这一战，飞快结束。
但滚滚如雷鸣的轰隆之声，依然把不远的灵运城的凡人们吓到，今天可是个艳阳高照的好天气。
机敏又见识广博的凡人，立刻想到了修士的打斗，更不要说城中的修士了。
“北边！”
“有修士打起来了！”
“瞧瞧去。”
很快，一道道身影，出城而来，赶到了之前的打斗山野上空，又飞快的找到了空桑道人和张铁树的尸体。
一群修士，围了过来，在半空里俯视打量着。
“是个冰修杀的。”
“不止如此，你们瞧瞧他们两胸膛上的印记，想起谁了吗？”
有人说道。
这话一出，其他修士，一起更加仔细打量，又露出思索之色。
……
“这是怒火道宗的宗主赢商，独门的狼虎冰神印，那个老狐狸还没死，又出山了？”
几息之后，一个中年道人惊呼出声，说完就朝四面的山野中看了出去，灵识也席卷如风暴，面色已经大变。
其他修士的神色，也不好看起来，浑身拔凉。
怒火道宗是这一片，最强的宗门，曾经的赢商，也是这一片，最强的修士，他的凶名，不是说笑，那真是一具具尸体堆出来，一汪汪的鲜血染出来的！
四面山野中，自然是再无其他人。
“别慌，只是残留的痕迹像狼虎冰神印，是不是还说不准呢，况且你等仔细瞧瞧——他们身上，致命的伤，可不只这一处。”

老者声音响起，慢条斯理。
说话的是个灰袍老者，目光机敏灵活。
众人闻言，一起转头，再次看起那两具尸体来。很快，就个个神色古怪起来。
“的确奇怪……”
“他们两个的致命伤，也可能是头颅那里的，而非这真假不知的狼虎冰神印。”
“看起来，这个凶手，仿佛是要嫁祸给赢商……”
众人纷纷开口。
而听到最后一句，众人神色，更加古怪起来，赢商这个老贼，还需要谁来嫁祸吗？他的名声还不够臭吗？况且他说不定早就已经死了。
“这到底是谁干的？”
众人面面相觑。
几息之后，还是那灰袍老者一声嘿笑，惹来所有人的目光。
“有意思，看来是有人，想把这一片的水搅混啊！”
“道兄此话，什么意思？”
“什么意思？”
灰袍老者扫了众人一圈，道：“怒火道宗已经没落，这一片修真界，当然要站出一个新的领头宗门来，有人怕是已经等不及了。”
这话一出，气氛瞬间就变了！
来的修士，基本上隶属于附近这一片的各个势力，他们的势力，当然眼馋怒火道宗没落后，留下的最强宗门的地位，宗门里，甚至都有过讨论。
但，这就开始了吗？
是哪一家先下手了？
不知不觉间，这帮家伙自己之间，已经剑拔弩张起来。
content_en:
;;
This battle ended quickly.
But the roaring sound like thunder still frightened the mortals in Lingyun City not far away. Today was a beautiful day with bright sunshine.
The astute and knowledgeable mortal immediately thought of the monks fighting, let alone the monks in the city.
"North!"
"Some monks started fighting!"
"Let's take a look."
Soon, one after another figures came out of the city and rushed to the mountains where the previous fight took place. They quickly found the bodies of Taoist Kongsang and Zhang Tieshu.
A group of monks gathered around and looked down in mid-air.
"It's an ice cultivator."
"More than that, look at the marks on their chests. Do you remember anyone?"
someone said.
As soon as these words came out, the other monks looked at him more carefully, and they looked thoughtful again.
…
"This is Ying Shang, the leader of the Wrath Dao Sect, the unique wolf-tiger ice god seal. That old fox is not dead yet, is he coming out again?"
A few breaths later, a middle-aged Taoist exclaimed. After saying this, he looked out into the surrounding mountains and fields. His spiritual consciousness also swept through like a storm, and his complexion changed drastically.
The expressions of the other monks didn't look good either, and they felt cold all over.
The Wrath Dao Sect is the strongest sect in this area, and the former Yingshang is also the strongest monk in this area. His evil reputation is no joke, it is really the result of corpses piled up and pools of blood stained!
Naturally, there was no one else in the surrounding mountains and wilderness.
"Don't panic, it's just that the remaining traces look like the Wolf-Tiger Ice God Seal. I can't tell for sure. Besides, take a closer look - this is not the only fatal injury on their bodies."
The old man's voice sounded, slowly.
The speaker was an old man in gray robes, his eyes were alert and flexible.
After hearing this, everyone turned their heads and looked at the two corpses again. Soon, everyone looked weird.
"It's really strange..."
"The fatal wounds on the two of them may have been on their heads, not on the unknown Wolf-Tiger Ice God Seal."
"It seems like this murderer wants to put the blame on Ying Shang..."
Everyone spoke one after another.
After hearing the last sentence, everyone's expressions became even weirder. Does Ying Shang, an old thief, need anyone else to frame the blame? Isn't his reputation bad enough? Besides, he might already be dead.
"Who did this?"
Everyone looked at each other.
A few breaths later, it was the old man in gray robe who laughed, attracting everyone's attention.
"Interesting, it seems that someone wants to muddy the waters here!"
"Brother Dao, what do you mean by this?"
"What do you mean?"
The old man in gray robe swept around everyone and said: "The Fury Dao Sect has declined. Of course, in this world of cultivation, a new leading sect must stand up. Some people may not be able to wait any longer."
As soon as these words came out, the atmosphere changed instantly!
The monks who came basically belonged to various forces in the nearby area. Of course, their power, and the status of the strongest sect left after the decline of the Greedy Fury Dao Sect, was even discussed within the sect.
But, is this the beginning?
Which company made the first move?
Unknowingly, these guys were already at war with each other.
